summary: Approve. All four checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets). The Revision can fast-forward origin/master (merge-base is an ancestor). The prior 'changes' defects are fixed and verified against local evidence: (1) the OpenRouter trace identity is now written as per-model modelOverrides.samplingParams in models.json, and the pinned Pi 0.84.1 provider-composer reads config.modelOverrides[model.id].samplingParams (dist/core/provider-composer.js) and merges it into the request body (pi-ai simple-options/openai-responses), so the trace metadata is no longer a silent no-op; the Go test asserts the exact models.json shape. (2) run-model.sh now invokes the exporter through 'uv run --extra langfuse python', installing the optional langfuse extra from the updated uv.lock instead of system python3. The exporter's real Langfuse SDK calls (create_dataset_item, get_dataset_run, dataset_run_items.create, create_score, scores.get_by_id, trace.list) were checked against the cached langfuse 4.14.4 SDK surface and match. Python exporter tests pass. No blocking findings remain.
